*Parāmāsagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.9) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and culminating work of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. It forms part of the complex combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, specifically cross-classifying the *parāmāsa-gocchaka* (the cluster of dyads pertaining to misapprehension or view-adherence) with the *kusalattika* (the fundamental triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena) across the conditional relations.
